1.reproduce_code:
import React from 'react';
import { TimePicker, TimePickerSelect, SelectItem } from 'carbon-components-react';

function TimePickerErrorWarningExample() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* -- Error State -- */}
      <TimePicker
        id="time-picker-error"
        labelText="Error"
        value="11:45"
        invalid
        invalidText="Error message goes here"
      >
        <TimePickerSelect id="time-picker-error-select-ampm" invalid>
          <SelectItem text="AM" value="AM" />
          <SelectItem text="PM" value="PM" />
        </TimePickerSelect>
        <TimePickerSelect id="time-picker-error-select-zone" invalid>
          <SelectItem text="Eastern Time (ET)" value="ET" />
          <SelectItem text="Pacific Time (PT)" value="PT" />
        </TimePickerSelect>
      </TimePicker>

      {/* -- Warning State -- */}
      <TimePicker
        id="time-picker-warning"
        labelText="Warning"
        value="11:45"
        warn
        warnText="Warning message goes here"
      >
        <TimePickerSelect id="time-picker-warning-select-ampm" warn>
          <SelectItem text="AM" value="AM" />
          <SelectItem text="PM" value="PM" />
        </TimePickerSelect>
        <TimePickerSelect id="time-picker-warning-select-zone" warn>
          <SelectItem text="Eastern Time (ET)" value="ET" />
          <SelectItem text="Central Time (CT)" value="CT" />
        </TimePickerSelect>
      </TimePicker>
    </>
  );
}

export default TimePickerErrorWarningExample;
1.explanation: We use the TimePicker component’s built-in invalid/ invalidText props to trigger the red error outline, icon, and message, and the new warn/ warnText props to produce the yellow warning state. By propagating the same invalid or warn prop to each nested TimePickerSelect, the AM/PM and timezone selectors also render with the appropriate outline and icon. The default Carbon spacing (1 rem) between the input text and icon is applied automatically via the component’s CSS.
1.bug_scenario: The new design requires the TimePicker’s text input to display a distinct error and warning state, consistent with other Carbon form components. In the error state, the input field is outlined in red, an error icon appears inside the field, and an error message is shown below. In the warning state, the outline turns yellow, a warning icon is displayed, and a warning message appears beneath the field. Both states preserve the standard 1 rem spacing between the input text and the icon, and they apply equally to the subsequent AM/PM and timezone selectors.
